stories.title: Coastal B.C. bracing for another fall storm as warnings issued, King Tides expected
stories.summary: Another frontal system is washing over coastal B.C., bringing heavy rains and strong winds, swelling waterways just as king tides peak this week.

stories.title: Author Galloway’s lawyer asks B.C. court for millions in defamation award
stories.summary: The lawyer for author and former UBC professor Steven Galloway says his client's accuser started rape allegations and encouraged others to spread the claims.

stories.title: Mortgage delinquency rate up 31% in Q3, driven by Ontario and B.C.: Equifax report
stories.summary: A new report suggests there's growing stress among homeowners, with some struggling to keep up with monthly mortgage payments as interest rates rise again.

stories.title: Leafs rally to beat Islanders, snap 9-game skid
stories.summary: The Toronto Maple Leafs spotted the New York Islanders a 2-0 lead on Monday and it appeared as if the Canadian visitors were on their way to a 10th straight loss.

stories.title: Dog recovering from attack by another dog on Vancouver’s DTES
stories.summary: Michael Brown told Global News his nine-year-old dog Cleto underwent surgery for a puncture on his backside after he was attacked by another dog on the Downtown Eastside.

stories.title: Court setback for major mining project in B.C.’s Golden Triangle
stories.summary: The Seabridge Gold KSM Project is being described as one of the world's largest undeveloped gold reserves and will be Canada's largest gold mine if it goes ahead.

stories.title: Man charged with second-degree murder in death of B.C. actor
stories.summary: Stewart McLean, 45, had not been seen since May 15 at his home in Lions Bay, which is about a 30-minute drive south of Squamish.

stories.title: B.C. woman dies outside emergency room that closes daily at 5 p.m.
stories.summary: A B.C. woman's family has been left shattered and grieving after she died outside of the closed emergency department at Port Hardy Hospital last week.
